After.description: What a hold's `after` waits for: another task to end, or a Linear issue to close.

Hold.description:
Why a task is held, and the conditions that release it once all of them hold. With none, a
person does.

after.description:
Other tasks' ids, or Linear issues such as `ENG-7`: until each task ends and each issue is
Done or Canceled. One value or a list.

blockers.description: Until the task's Linear issue has no open blocker.

if_closed.description: What a pull request closed without a merge does: `release`, `drop` or `ask`, the default.

merge.description:
Pull requests, `owner/name#42` or `42` in the task's repository: until each merges. One
value or a list.

reason.description: Why the task waits, shown to a person.

until.description: An RFC 3339 instant, or a duration such as `2 hours` after the hold.

OneOrMany_After.description: One value, or a list of them; null reads as none, as the single values it replaced did.

OneOrMany_string.description: One value, or a list of them; null reads as none, as the single values it replaced did.

TaskRequested.description: A request for a task. Only this message creates a task.

band.description: The trigger's or the request's band.

hold.description: Files the task held: the trigger's `hold`, or `priory request --hold`.

key.description: Which events are the same work, such as `github:owner/name#42` or `linear:ENG-7`.

lane.description: The trigger's or the request's lane; null when `lanes.toml` derives it.

project.description: The Linear issue's project name, or null without one. Linear sources only.

prompt.description: The trigger's `prompt`, or null without one. Schedule sources only.

repo.description:
The repository the task works in: `priory request --repo` for a CLI request, the pull
request's for a review request. Those sources only.

scheduled.description: When the firing was due. Schedule sources only.

source.description: The `id` of the source event's message.

team.description: The Linear issue's team key. Linear sources only.

description: A request for a task. Only this message creates a task.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: factory.task.requested
